title: Continue a show notes or history window after a newer record is appended instead of refusing it as changed
outcome: Continue a show notes or history window after a newer record is appended instead of refusing it as changed
acceptance: A show notes/history/observations/evaluations continuation keeps returning the older rows it announced when a newer record (for example an ordinary note) is appended to the same item after the first page; it is refused only when the rows at or before its boundary actually changed or the item's run or policy changed
A behaviour test pages a notes window, appends a note to the same item, then follows the continuation and receives the remaining older rows without duplicates or gaps

completion.summary: Continuation windows now survive newer appends while preserving boundary-change refusal; regression test passed. Landed b5045331 on origin/master and installed its Release binary with ready=true; previous debug install retained as backup. Independent evaluation passed both criteria. TermAl run test-a6595018 was invalidated by the earlier debug install collision and was reported to Opus2/Fable; no rerun was performed.
